chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'My community has not been given anything more scarcely than three things: beauty, a beautiful voice, and memorisation (of the Quran).'

key_terms.أُمَّة: The Muslim community (umma); the followers of the Prophet
key_terms.الصَّوْت الْحَسَن: Beautiful/melodious voice, especially for Quranic recitation
key_terms.الْحِفْظ: Memorisation, specifically the memorisation of the Quran (hifz)

ai.seo_question: What three gifts did the Prophet say are scarce in his community?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) narrates a saying of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) in which the Prophet identifies three gifts that are exceedingly rare in his community: physical beauty, a beautiful voice, and the ability to memorize (the Quran). The hadith appears in the chapter on the recitation of the Quran with a melodious voice, contextualising the 'beautiful voice' as specifically referring to Quranic recitation. This scarcity is presented not as a deprivation but as an indication of how precious and extraordinary these gifts are when possessed.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Ali Bin Ma’bad, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘My<sup>saww</sup> community has not been Given anything more scarcely than three (things) – the beauty, and the beautiful voice, and the memorisation (of the Holy Quran)’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ali ibn Ma’bad from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Qasim from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘What my followers have received is no less than three things: Beauty, attractive voice and memorization. ’”
